description: List the workspace's recent imports, newest first, a page at a time: each one's file name, who started it, its `state` (`open`, `expired` or `committed`) and its counts, which are the commit's, or the last dry run's until it is committed. It never carries the file's columns, cells or failed rows: open one with get_contact_import. An import left open is deleted 24 hours after it started, and a committed one drops out of the list 7 days after its commit.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

name: list_contact_imports
title: List contact imports
